tax.policy.pl_belka.name: Regular (Belka 19%)
tax.policy.pl_belka.hint: A 19% tax on gains from sales and on dividends, counted by FIFO in złoty.
tax.policy.pl_belka.summary: Belka, one PIT-38 for all accounts: FIFO within an account, the NBP rate of the last business day before the trade, 19%, the yearly balance of all brokers
tax.policy.pl_belka.estimate_note: This is an estimate. The brokers' PIT-8C and your tax adviser are authoritative. Gains and losses of all accounts are balanced in one PIT-38, as in the declaration.
tax.policy.pl_belka.overview_hint: Belka for this year as of today: realised gains and losses and dividends of all taxable accounts together (one PIT-38). The unrealised result is not included.
tax.policy.pl_belka.progress_note: PIT-38 across all accounts for each day: gains and losses are balanced, dividends count the tax paid abroad.
tax.policy.pl_belka.losses_note: A loss from a filed PIT-38: it reduces the gain of the next 5 years, by at most 50% of the loss a year. One loss per year — for the declaration it is yours, not an account's, and it replaces the one counted from the journal. “Already used” is what was deducted in declarations for years not in the journal.

tax.policy.pl_ike.hint: A retirement account: no tax on gains unless withdrawn before retirement.
tax.policy.pl_ikze.name: IKZE
tax.policy.pl_ikze.hint: A retirement account with a tax deduction on contributions; tax only on withdrawal.
tax.policy.pl_belka.disclaimer: An estimate: the final tax follows the broker's PIT-8C.

pit38.fact.withheld_abroad: Withheld abroad from them (in poz. 48 at most 19% of each)
pit38.hint.zg_income: Gain from selling securities of this country (by ISIN)
pit38.hint.zg_tax: The broker withholds no tax on sales
pit38.hint.p20_ours: Our calculation — enter poz. 35 from the PIT-8C
pit38.hint.p21_ours: Our calculation — enter poz. 36 from the PIT-8C
pit38.hint.p22: Sales at brokers without a PIT-8C, at the NBP rate of the day before the trade
pit38.hint.p23: Purchase of the sold lots (FIFO) and the buy and sell fees
pit38.hint.p29: A loss can be deducted from the income of the next 5 years, up to half a year
pit38.hint.p30: At most half of each year's loss over the last 5 years and at most poz. 28
pit38.hint.p34: No tax was withheld on sales abroad
pit38.hint.p47: 19% of gross foreign dividends (before withholding abroad), of all brokers
pit38.hint.p48: Tax withheld abroad, at most 19% of each dividend
pit38.hint.p72: One PIT/ZG for each country with income from sales; dividends are not part of it
pit38.note.rates: Amounts in PLN at the NBP average rate of the last business day before the trade or payment date (art. 11a). The law ties income to the transfer of ownership (art. 17 ust. 1ab) — some brokers and advisers take the rate of the day before the settlement date (T+1 US, T+2 EU), then the amounts differ slightly.
pit38.note.form_numbers: Field numbers follow the PIT-38(18) form and the Ministry of Finance brochure for 2025.
pit38.note.form_numbers_old: Field numbers follow the PIT-38(18) form for 2025; the form for {year} is not out yet — check the numbers when it is published.
pit38.note.form_numbers_old_short: poz. numbers follow the 2025 form: check them against the form for {year}.
pit38.note.crypto: Parts E/F (cryptocurrencies) are not filled in: if you have crypto, enter them yourself.
pit38.note.missing_pit8c: Row 1 — {brokers}: enter the amounts from the broker's PIT-8C (poz. 35 and 36; one PIT-8C for all your accounts at this broker), and the rest of the form is recalculated from them.
pit38.note.missing_pit8c_short: poz. 20/21: enter poz. 35/36 from the PIT-8C ({brokers}), here is our calculation.
pit38.note.foreign_dividends_polish_brok: Foreign dividends from a Polish broker go in part G: the broker is not their payer. The exception is shares of foreign companies on the GPW from which the broker itself withheld 19% (visible in the statement): remove those from poz. 47/48.
pit38.note.withholding_unknown: Foreign dividends without data on tax withheld abroad ({count}): poz. 47 is counted from the received amount, poz. 48 without it, so the tax is overstated. Upload the broker's report (Revolut P&L) or check the gross and withheld amounts yourself. If nothing was withheld abroad (e.g. Irish ETFs), it is all correct.
pit38.note.withholding_unknown_short: Dividends without data on withholding abroad ({count}): check poz. 47/48 against the broker's statements.
pit38.note.polish_dividends: {count} dividends of Polish companies are not in part G: the Polish payer withholds the tax.
pit38.note.polish_dividends_abroad: {count} dividends of Polish companies are not in part G: the Polish payer withholds the tax. At a foreign broker check that the 19% was really withheld — otherwise it must be entered in poz. 46.
pit38.note.polish_dividends_abroad_short: Dividends of Polish companies at a foreign broker: if 19% was not withheld, enter it in poz. 46.
pit38.note.loss: A loss for the year: file the PIT-38 anyway — without it the loss cannot be deducted in later years.
pit38.note.loss_short: A loss: file the PIT-38 anyway to deduct it in later years.
pit38.note.carryforward: poz. 30 follows the “up to 50% of a year's loss” rule and assumes that each past declaration deducted as much as allowed. If less was deducted or nothing was filed, the amount differs. The law also allows deducting up to 5 000 000 zł of one loss once in 5 years — then change the amount yourself.
pit38.note.zg: PIT/ZG: the country follows the security's ISIN. Whether PIT/ZG is required when no tax on sales was withheld abroad is disputed (the Ministry's brochure ties it to the proportional deduction method), but e-Urząd requires it for income from abroad, and it changes nothing in the tax.
pit38.note.unknown_country: {count} sales without a country in the ISIN (no ISIN or XS/EU): they are not in PIT/ZG — check the issuer's country.
pit38.note.unknown_country_short: {count} sales without a country in the ISIN — they are not in PIT/ZG.
pit38.note.over_treaty: {count} dividends withheld above the treaty rate (no W-8BEN?). Here the credit goes up to 19% (art. 30a ust. 9, NSA); the tax office (KIS) credits only at the treaty rate — then poz. 48 = {credit}, poz. 49 = {difference} zł.
pit38.note.over_treaty_short: Withheld above the treaty rate: by the KIS position poz. 48 = {credit}, poz. 49 = {difference} zł.
